void.$description: Void — Universal canvas, page background, default text, hairline borders, monogram fills. Pure black, no warm or cool bias — used at maximum density to let white type and color accents do all the work

bone.$description: Bone — Primary headings, body copy on dark, inverse button labels, inverted card surfaces for case studies

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated card and button-fill surfaces sitting one step above the black canvas. Slightly warm-tinted dark gray

ink.$description: Ink — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary button borders and button text — a mid-gray frame for outlined/ghost controls on dark

mist.$description: Mist — De-emphasized body text and subtle border work when pure white would overstate the hierarchy

parchment.$description: Parchment — Light input field background — a warm near-white that gives the rare form elements a paper-like quality against the black void

neon-magenta.$description: Neon Magenta — Pink action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ember-dot.$description: Ember Dot — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Decorative illustration fill used in data-visualization case study artwork. Not an interface token — appears inside graphics

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

ozik-black.$description: Display wordmark only — the brand's signature act. 358px condensed ultra-black with distinctive cut-out apertures in the 'a' and 'd' forms. No substitute captures the same geometric density; treat as a logo asset, not a system font.

basis-grotesque-pro.$description: Primary body and heading family for all running text and subheadings. Aggressive negative tracking at large sizes (–0.04em at 80px) tightens the geometric forms; at body sizes tracking relaxes to near-normal. The wide size range (14–80px) and tight leading (1.00–1.10 for display) let it carry both paragraph text and large editorial headlines.

martian-mono.$description: UI chrome — nav labels, button text, tags, case study categories, time stamps, and the 'CASE STUDIES' / 'MICROSOFT' / 'NIKE' labels. The tracked-out positive spacing (0.05–0.10em) on small sizes creates a typewriter/terminal feel that codes the meta-information as system, not content. All caps throughout.
